# northflank_service (Data Source)

Looks up a Northflank service of any kind -- deployment, combined or build -- either by its `id` or by its `name`. Set exactly one of them.

Attributes that do not apply to the service's kind are null: a build service has no instances or ports. The runtime environment is not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Any kind of service: deployment, combined or build.
data "northflank_service" "api" {
  project_id = "my-application"
  name       = "API"
}

# Run a job from the same image as an existing service.
resource "northflank_job" "backfill" {
  project_id      = "my-application"
  name            = "Backfill"
  deployment_plan = data.northflank_service.api.deployment_plan

  deployment = {
    external_image = {
      image_path = data.northflank_service.api.image_path
    }
    command = "node backfill.js"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the service belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the service. Set this to look the service up by ID.
- `name` (String) Name of the service. Set this to look the service up by name, which lists the project's services to find it.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) Full identifier Northflank uses for the service's deployment.
- `branch` (String) Branch a combined service builds and deploys. Null for other kinds.
- `build_service_id` (String) Build service a deployment service runs the output of, when it does.
- `command` (String) Command override. Null when the image's `CMD` is used.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time, in RFC 3339 format.
- `deployment_plan` (String) ID of the compute plan the service runs on.
- `description` (String) Short description of the service.
- `entrypoint` (String) Entrypoint override. Null when the image's `ENTRYPOINT` is used.
- `image_path` (String) Image a deployment service runs, when it runs an external image.
- `instances` (Number) Number of instances. Null for a build service.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Ports the service listens on. Empty for a build service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `repository_url` (String) Git repository a build or combined service builds from.
- `service_type` (String) `deployment`, `combined` or `build`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags attached to the service.
- `uid` (String) Permanent identifier of the service. Unlike `id`, it never changes and is never reused.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `disable_nf_domain` (Boolean) Whether the port's default `code.run` domain is turned off.
- `domains` (Set of String) Custom domains routed to this port.
- `internal_port` (Number) Port number the container listens on.
- `name` (String) Name identifying the port.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTP/2`, `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the port is exposed to the internet.
